final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS order_channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_units_filled, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.orderbase), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM grouped) SELECT g.order_channel, g.avg_units_filled, g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / t.total_count FROM grouped g JOIN totals t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL
